summary: Extended the App.test.ts timeout to 5 seconds and ran a single test successfully, then inspected the working tree with git status/diff. Made several edits to apps/agent-server/tests/sessions/pi-agent-service.test.ts to add an isolated test setup, a temporary override profile, and cleanup of the extension registry between tests.
decisions: Increase findByText timeout in apps/app/src/App.test.ts to 5_000 ms to accommodate the slower test environment
In pi-agent-service.test.ts, create a temporary override profile (base: active.id, tools/prompt modes 'default'/'pi-default') instead of mutating the active profile directly
Call registerExtensions([]) in the test cleanup to reset the global extension registry between tests
